name: millimetre-ruler-scale
title: Millimetre Ruler Scale
description: A physical ruler rendered in CSS: millimetre ticks every 4px, centimetre ticks taller with numerals, edge-accurate against the page — hold a credit card against it in the demo to check your screen's true DPI.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Drag Measure: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
